title: Figure 2.6: 3He Ion Source for 3He-3He Fusion Rate Studies at the U of Wisconsin
description: Color 3D cutaway rendering of a spherical IEC vacuum chamber with multiple ports, a central grid with a glowing core, and an attached Helicon ion source. A cyan ion beam is shown passing along the source axis through two dark semicircular magnet blocks. Caption reads 'Figure 2.6. 3He Ion Source for Use in 3He-3He Fusion Rate Studies at the U of Wisconsin'.
